primary_mechanic.text: Help households through changes by bringing what each needs, with family rulings kept to an information area (65:6-7).

story_library.source: Owner's 'Quran Adventure — Children's Story Library' (2026-11-04), first-draft narration for ages about 7-12
story_library.title: Caring Through Change
story_library.children_narration: Families sometimes experience difficult changes. Surah At-Talaq gives adults responsibilities to act fairly, provide appropriate care, and avoid causing harm. It reminds us that even during hardship, people should act with compassion and trust in Allah.

world_idea.title: The Neighborhood of Care
world_idea.description: A gentle community-care environment with activities about making people feel supported during changes. Family-law rulings are explained in an age-appropriate information area rather than turned into children's decisions.

story_library.checks: Every reference exists in the verified text (checked 2026-11-04). Narration is draft, written by the owner, not reviewed by a scholar.
